meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把对话压缩成交接文档,让下一个智能体顺利接手。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在多个智能体之间接力完成任务。
copy.tagline_en: Compress the conversation into a handoff doc for the next agent.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to hand off context between agents in a multi-step task.

howto.what: 把当前对话整理成一份交接文档,供新的 agent 接手继续做事。文档存到系统临时目录(不是工作区),含「建议调用的技能」一节,并隐去 API key、密码等敏感信息;已写进规格、计划、提交等其他材料的内容只按路径或链接引用。
howto.when: 需要让新的 agent 接手当前工作时,由你手动调用(不会自动触发)。调用时传入的参数会被当作下个会话重点的描述,并据此调整文档内容。

say.text: 把当前对话整理成交接文档,下个会话我要接着做登录重构
say.note: 文档存到系统临时目录,并围绕该主题组织

say.text: 生成一份交接文档给下一个 agent,重点是修支付 bug
say.note: 参数会作为下个会话重点写进文档

say.text: 写交接文档,记得隐去密钥,规格里已有的就别重复写
say.note: 敏感信息会被隐去,已有材料只做引用

howto.what_en: Compacts the current conversation into a handoff doc so a fresh agent can continue. Saved to the OS temp dir, not the workspace; includes suggested skills, redacts sensitive info, references other artifacts by path or URL.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a fresh agent to take over the current work; invoked manually by you, not automatically, and arguments describe what the next session will focus on.

say_en.text: Write a handoff doc from this conversation; the next session is the login refactor.
say_en.note: Saves to the OS temp dir, not the workspace.

say_en.text: Generate a handoff doc for the next agent, focused on fixing the payment bug.
say_en.note: Your argument shapes the doc's focus.

say_en.text: Create a handoff doc, redact keys, and skip what the specs already cover.
say_en.note: Sensitive data is redacted, artifacts just referenced.
